name: Satou Yahiro
source:
3rd year student. Star Sign: Capricorn.
President of the Wind Instrument Club and leader of the brass instrument section. He plays the trombone.
A serious and hard working guy.
He has a reserved personality, so he has a hard time saying strong words to other people.
